prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 20 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1130; do not mention it.)
text:
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and intermittent headaches radiating to the base of the skull. Examination revealed reduced cervical range of motion, particularly in rotation and extension, with paraspinal muscle tenderness and mild muscle guarding. Neurological screening was within normal limits, with no radicular symptoms, motor weakness, or sensory deficits. Imaging was not indicated at initial presentation given the absence of red-flag findings.

Treatment over the course of care included a combination of manual therapy, soft tissue mobilization, progressive therapeutic exercise for cervical stabilization, and home exercise instruction. Over twenty visits, the patient demonstrated steady improvement in pain scores, range of motion, and functional tolerance for daily activities and computer work. Headache frequency decreased substantially by the midpoint of care.

At discharge, the patient reported minimal residual neck discomfort with occasional stiffness after prolonged positioning. Range of motion was near baseline, and strength was symmetric. The patient was discharged to an independent home exercise program with instructions to return if symptoms recur or worsen.
